name: Festival Stone of Morningthaw
title: Festival Stone of Morningthaw
summary: The Stone of Morningthaw, a Festival Stone on a grassy plateau (z 108) south-east of Rithwic (acpedia). The acpedia map point (33.3N 53.3E) is 186 m off; the stone stands at 33.58N 54.02E (gazetteer 'morningthaw-festival-stone', matching acpedia's second coordinate 33.6N 54.0E). It is flanked by two 5.5 m ancient stone columns, a fallen ancient block and the Broken Seal of the Elder Spirits; big trees (to 40 m) stand 30-40 m away and the plateau drops to the west. Landblocks 0xC4A8-AA (x > 37632) are missing from the kit; all filming stays west of them.
